;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]], [[Afghan peace process]]
**[[United States|American]] and [[Taliban|Afghan Taliban]] leaders will meet at the [[Sheraton Grand Doha Resort & Convention Hotel]] in [[Doha]], [[Qatar]], ahead of a signing ceremony to bring an end to the 18-year war in [[Afghanistan]], which is now the longest war in U.S. history. Taliban deputy leader [[Sirajuddin Haqqani]] says "everyone is tired of war, it has exhausted everyone", while the [[Resolute Support Mission|longest-serving NATO Commander]] in Afghanistan, General [[John W. Nicholson Jr.|John Nicholson]], describes the situation as a "stalemate". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/taliban-set-sign-deal-war-afghanistan-200228055452287.html (Al Jazeera)]
**The U.S. and the Taliban sign [[Afghan peace process#2020 agreement|a deal]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-afghanistan-taliban-details-factb/factbox-details-of-the-deal-signed-between-the-united-states-and-the-taliban-idUSKBN20N0OS (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian civil war]], [[Northwestern Syria offensive (December 2019–March 2020)]]
**A Turkish soldier is killed and six more are wounded by Syrian government artillery shelling near [[Taftanaz]]. [http://www.syriahr.com/?p=366030 (SOHR)]
**Turkish bombing overnight kills 48 Syrian government troops and 14 members of the Lebanese [[Hezbollah]], and also destroys 13 military vehicles. According to local sources, among the killed were 11 officers including a [[Army general|general]], a [[brigadier general]], and a [[colonel]]. [http://www.haber7.com/guncel/haber/2947890-esede-sok-ustune-sok-nokta-operasyonda-kritik-isimler-de-olduruldu (Haber 7)] [http://www.syriahr.com/?p=366034 (SOHR)]
**Turkey says it has destroyed a [[chemical warfare]] facility at a scientific research center in [[As-Safira]], south of [[Aleppo]] with [[Surface-to-surface missile|surface-to-surface missiles]]. Syrian Government said Turkish statement regarding the chemical warfare facility was not true. [http://www.syriahr.com/?p=366030 (SOHR)] [https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/syrian-govt-denies-erdogans-claims-about-turkey-destroying-chemical-weapons-facility/ (''Al-Masdar News'')]
**Turkey releases footage of targeting Syrian equipment including a [[Pantsir missile system|Pantsir-S1]]. [https://www.thedrive.com/the-war-zone/32394/turkey-strikes-back-and-calls-for-no-fly-zone-after-its-troops-die-in-syria-airstrikes (The Drive)]
**Turkish media said that drone and missile strikes targeted Syrian [[Kuweires Military Aviation Institute|Kuweires]] and [[Abu al-Duhur Military Airbase|Abu al-Duhur]] military airbases in [[Aleppo Governorate]], saying a [[Hangar|hangar]] was destroyed. [https://www.star.com.tr/savunma/rejimin-hava-ussu-yerle-bir-edildi-haber-1518907/ (STAR)] 

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**The [[United Arab Emirates]] suspends all extracurricular school activities and orders nurseries closed until further notice as measures to prevent the spreading of the virus. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/gulf/2020/02/29/UAE-suspends-school-activities-as-part-of-coronavirus-preventative-measure.html (Al Arabiya English)]
**An elderly woman traveling from [[Spain]] becomes the first case of coronavirus in [[Ecuador]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-health-ecuador/ecuador-confirms-its-first-case-of-new-coronavirus-idUSKBN20N0S5 (Reuters)]
**The first case of [[COVID-19]] is confirmed in [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]], [[Qatar]] and [[Luxembourg]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/coronavirus/2020/0229/1119357-coronavirus-ireland/ (RTE.ie)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-health-luxembourg/luxembourg-reports-first-coronavirus-case-rtl-idUSKBN20N111 (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/qatar-reports-coronavirus-case-citizen-iran-200229144225648.html (Al Jazeera)]
**A 78-year-old man evacuated from the [[Diamond Princess (ship)|Diamond Princess]] becomes the first death from coronavirus in Australia. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/mar/01/dutton-says-extending-travel-ban-not-possible-and-defends-coronavirus-response (''The Guardian'')]

***The first death from coronavirus in the [[United States]] is confirmed after a man dies in a hospital in the [[Seattle]] area. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/02/29/world/coronavirus-news.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://apnews.com/f175d89567a26d59cab27725c9e8a0d7 (AP News)]
***The U.S. announces new travel restrictions to [[Iran]] and increased warnings against traveling to [[South Korea]] and [[Italy]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/coronavirus-trump-give-update-white-house-saturday-n1145921 (NBC News)]

*Eighty [[Human migration|migrants]] cross to [[Aegean Islands]] [[Lesbos]] and [[Samos]] overnight after Turkey opens [[Greece-Turkey border|its border with]] [[Greece]]. [https://www.hurriyet.com.tr/gundem/sinir-kapilari-acildi-akin-akin-avrupaya-41457864 (''Hürriyet'')]
*[[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan|Recep Erdoğan]] says 18,000 refugees have crossed into [[Europe]] as of this morning and that 25,000–30,000 more may cross today.
